changeSet.author: carlos.villada
changeSet.comment: Crea la tabla course_materials: apuntes y lecturas de un curso que alimentan el RAG (R-004), con el texto ya extraído por la API y su origen (licencia). Incluye secuencia propia, tabla de auditoría course_materials_audit y sus triggers.

createTable.remarks: Notes and readings uploaded by the instructor as RAG sources of a course, besides the syllabus (R-004). Written by the API, read by ai

column.name: id
column.remarks: Primary key

column.name: public_id
column.remarks: Public identifier exposed by the API instead of the sequential id

column.name: course_id
column.remarks: Course the material belongs to

column.name: source_type
column.remarks: Source type: pdf or text (TXT and MD files are text)

column.name: origin
column.remarks: Origin of the material, used as its license: own_notes, open_license or permitted

column.name: file_name
column.remarks: Original file name

column.name: file_sha256
column.remarks: SHA-256 of the file, used to avoid duplicates in the course

column.name: byte_size
column.remarks: Size in bytes

column.name: page_count
column.remarks: Number of pages of the PDF

column.name: extracted_char_count
column.remarks: Characters extracted from the document

column.name: extracted_text
column.remarks: Text extracted from the document

column.name: active
column.remarks: Logical state: false means deactivated (rows are never deleted)

column.name: created_at
column.remarks: Creation timestamp

column.name: updated_at
column.remarks: Last update timestamp, maintained by the set_updated_at trigger

changeSet.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX course_materials_course_sha256_active_uq ON course_materials (course_id, file_sha256) WHERE active
ALTER TABLE course_materials ADD CONSTRAINT course_materials_source_type_ck CHECK (source_type IN ('pdf', 'text'))
ALTER TABLE course_materials ADD CONSTRAINT course_materials_origin_ck CHECK (origin IN ('own_notes', 'open_license', 'permitted'))
CREATE TRIGGER course_materials_set_updated_at_trg BEFORE UPDATE ON course_materials FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at()

column.name: audit_id
column.remarks: Primary key of the audit row

column.name: record_id
column.remarks: Id of the audited row in course_materials

column.name: operation
column.remarks: INSERT, UPDATE or DELETE

column.name: old_data
column.remarks: Row before the change

column.name: new_data
column.remarks: Row after the change

column.name: changed_at
column.remarks: Moment of the change

column.name: db_user
column.remarks: Database user that made the change

column.name: app_user_id
column.remarks: Application user that made the change (smartmentor.current_user_id)

changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE course_materials_audit ADD CONSTRAINT course_materials_audit_operation_ck CHECK (operation IN ('INSERT', 'UPDATE', 'DELETE'))
CREATE TRIGGER course_materials_audit_trg AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OR DELETE ON course_materials FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit_row_change()

rollback.sql: DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS course_materials_audit_trg ON course_materials
